_comment: WebSocket migration freeze baseline (websocket-migration plan §2.7). commit_baseline is a per-file CEILING of .commit() calls in production write paths: CI fails if a file exceeds its entry, or if a file with commits has no entry. As each phase migrates write paths onto in_tx, the corresponding entry is decremented or removed; reaching {} by Phase 5 is the 'all write paths on in_tx' signal. grandfathered_trigger_migrations are the only migrations allowed to contain CREATE TRIGGER / pg_notify; any new migration with one fails CI.
